plan.question: Does preserving small branch magnitudes while bounding large ones improve both residual teachers under the original learning budget?
plan.motivation: The best completed learned-even, all-bias, decay0.1 residual configuration passes17/24. Every strong mixed-teacher case still fails despite fitting training data. Post-RMS maps almost every nonzero raw branch toward unit RMS, discarding radial information and having real global Lipschitz bound1/sqrt(epsilon). Test one amplitude-preserving alternative; this diagnosis is a hypothesis, not a causal finding.
plan.single_change: Replace branch-output RMS only by P(z)=z/max(1,sqrt(mean(z^2))). This is Euclidean projection onto the radius sqrt(d) ball. Keep input RMS at the original FP32 epsilon, learned-even activation initialized at zero, hidden/output biases, zero-initialized ReZero gates after the branch operation divided by sqrt(depth), all matrices and RNG draws. Use FP64 norm/division intermediates and cast back, recording this implementation choice. Do not change the full GPT.
plan.unchanged_protocol: Both fixed sphere-input teachers; depths4/16, strengths0.25/1, seeds0/1/2; dimension16/hidden43; train512 and heldout512, data seed1; batch64, full512updates even after crossing, cadence32,warmup16; native AdamW betas0.9/0.98,epsilon1e-8,weight_decay0.1 on all parameters;initial matrix std0.1;first heldout relativeMSE<=0.05;CPU FP32highest,one thread. Preserve data,thresholds,budgets,initial parameter tensors/order/count and batch order.
plan.controls: Reuse all24 learned-even/all-bias cells from the completed bias study, including7misses. This follows that study's already declared pooled selection, without teacher-specific architecture choice. No augmentation or new data. Keep the earlier soft-epsilon negative experiments; ball projection is a different function that is exactly identity inside the ball.
plan.selection: Require all48 exact cells. Rank both modes across both teachers by pooled coverage, then geometric-mean first-crossing updates only if all24 pass; otherwise worst final heldout relativeMSE,median tie-break. Retain each paired seed and both teacher totals. No successful-only aggregate or relaxed0.05 threshold.
plan.validation: Before training, verify all original parameters/RNG/capacity and initial identity; active-gate forward/backward against independent reference; zero,inside,outside and boundary projection behavior; analytic VJP and bounded/nonexpansive behavior in80 numeric cases; exact unchanged training AST except constructor; retained24controls and complete-grid selection. Freeze tested source and proof evidence before training. Audit all24checkpoints by full split re-evaluation plus optimizer,sampler,initial states,histories and crossings.
plan.mathematical_scope: Prove real branch radius and identity-inside-ball properties and, if established, global Euclidean nonexpansiveness1. Derive post-gate and residual norm bounds explicitly. The projection is nonsmooth on the boundary; test the implemented exterior derivative selection, do not claim classical differentiability there. Input RMS, learned FFN, freely learned gates and whole-network/learning are not uniformly controlled by the projection theorem.
plan.source_policy: New sibling package, preserve all frozen sources. Copy the original bias training loop changing only constructor/import and function name; all capacity metadata retained. Archive exact source,plan,tests,numeric/proof evidence before training. Separate audits outside the frozen training package.
plan.scope: Adaptive synthetic residual follow-up, independent of the ongoing inverse-width early99 long diagnostic. No long-suite outcome motivates, selects or tunes this experiment.

parent_settings.data: Independent Gaussian vectors normalized to RMS one. A fixed random orthogonal R defines targets y=x+a*tanh(xR), at strengths a=0.25 and 1.0. All seeds, variants and depths share both fixed splits and R. No learned readout hides the residual task.
parent_settings.models: Every branch uses the same initialized bias-free SwiGLU F(RMS(h)). pre_unit adds the raw branch; peri_unit adds RMS(F); peri_sqrt adds RMS(F)/sqrt(D); peri_depth adds RMS(F)/D. peri_post_gate multiplies the peri_sqrt branch by 2*sigmoid(s), s=0. peri_pre_gate instead puts that gain inside output RMS. peri_rezero uses s/sqrt(D), s=0, after output RMS. These are isolated adaptations, not reproductions of entire ReZero or mHC training recipes. Gates add D scalar parameters; all original matrices and batch orders match.
parent_settings.measurement: Run every cell for all 512 updates unless a numerical failure occurs; observe full train/held-out relative MSE at step zero and every 32 updates. Relative MSE divides by mean squared teacher residual y-x on the same split. Record first <=0.05 crossing, final losses, hidden norms, gradient norms and final input-Jacobian singular values. Preserve all histories, checkpoints, optimizer state and fingerprints.
parent_settings.ranking: Rank by number of the 12 cells per variant reaching threshold. If all 12 pass, compare geometric-mean first-crossing updates. Otherwise compare worst final relative MSE across all 12 (nonfinite is worst); use median final error only as a tie-break. Report all seed/depth/strength regressions. Best means best among these declared small residual tests; it does not authorize replacing the main transformer. No retuning after outcomes.
